text:
maria: quick post-incident note: we saw anomalous privileged token activity hitting the audit pipeline at ~02:12 UTC. containment done (isolated svcacct, blocked outbound) — no confirmed customer data exfil.

kevin: nice work. can you drop the short timeline and root cause hypothesis here?

maria: timeline: 02:10 alert from canary -> 02:12 elevated token usage -> 02:14 blocked svcacct, rotated keys -> 02:25 confirmed no live reads from customer buckets. preliminary RCA points to a mis-scoped service account that had a historical role binding (roles/storage.admin) from an old migration script.

aj: ouch. so RBAC drift + automation = exploit surface. do we have which role grants were the culprit?

maria: yes — legacy-project-migration-sa had bindings on project:cloud-storage with storage.admin. ticketed in JIRA IN-3456.

sec-bot: incident created: SEC-789, severity=high, owner=maria, status=triage

sophia: proposed immediate post-incident actions (short list):
- revoke/rotate svcacct credentials (done)
- audit all project-level role bindings from last 18 months
- add org-level deny rule to block legacy-project-migration-sa from storage.admin
- force KMS rewrap for artifacts encrypted with old key version
- extend audit logging retention to 1 year for admin-level ops
- add RBAC drift job to weekly infra tests

kevin: add me for the KMS piece. question: do we rekey or rewrap? rekey has more blast radius. recommend rewrap with new key version and rotate keys in place.

aj: want to confirm rollback plan if rewrap hits failures. we should be able to revert to prior key version and abort. add runbook step.

maria: putting a short runbook excerpt here for the KMS step:
```
- set MAINT window
- create new key version in primary key ring
- run verify-only pass: kms rewrap --dry-run --filter 'resource:artifacts/*'
- run rewrap in batches (1000 objects/min) with retry
- monitor audit logs for decrypt failures
- on failure: pause, revert key routing, contact oncall
```

sophia: also policy change: require `iam.requesterPays` for legacy buckets? kidding. but seriously, add a policy requiring no project-level admin bindings without two approvers.

kevin: agree. also pushing for automated pre-commit check for terraform to flag `google_project_iam_binding` with high-priv roles.

maria: owners + short assignments:
- RBAC audit (scope & remediation): aj (SEC-790)
- KMS rewrap plan + execution: kevin (SEC-791)
- Audit retention config & SIEM rules: sophia (SEC-792)
- Runbook updates & tabletop planning: dylan (SEC-793)
- Customer comms draft (if needed): maria / support (SEC-794)

dylan: for tabletop — propose Thu 10:00 PST, 60m. objective: walk detection -> containment -> comms -> postmortems. who needs to be present? sec, eng-sre, platform, support.

aj: Thu works for me. can we add a short preread (1 pager) linking to IN-3456 and SEC-789?

maria: will assemble preread. include suggested customer statement: "We detected unauthorized usage of a legacy internal credential that has been revoked; no customer data access identified. We are rotating keys and hardening RBAC. We will notify customers if we determine any impact."

sophia: add monitoring items: alert on sudden increase in admin-level API calls, produce daily diff of org-level role bindings, and add email escalation to sec-oncall.

kevin: KMS question from earlier: how long until we can finish a safe rewrap? estimate 6-12 hours depending on artifact count; will instrument progress metrics.

aj: vuln triage note: we should label this as "RBAC drift -> elevated privilege used" and add a mitigations checklist in vuln tracker.

maria: created the JIRA suite: IN-3456 (RCA), SEC-789 (incident), SEC-790..794 for action owners. linking here: https://jira.internal/redwood/SEC-789 

dylan: tabletop invite sent. agenda + preread uploaded: https://docs.internal/redwood/incident/sec789-preread 

maria: final note — let's push one quick low-effort telemetry: produce a canary alert for any svcacct that gets storage.admin role bound post-date X. low false positives, high signal. assign to aj.

aj: on it. will add detection + automated remediation (unbind then notify).

kevin: thanks team. please update your tickets; we will review at tabletop. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: SEC-789 moved to "post-incident" status."
